title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode4 Blue Skies Beyond Reach

meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_idol_op2
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
That concludes this homeroom.
Please don't forget to review what we covered and read ahead.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I don't have any extracurricular activities scheduled for today, so I might make that poster for the children's center before going home...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And then, I'll start getting ready for that volunteer nursing home visit.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's going to be my first time visiting that facility, so I'll need to do some research to see what the atmosphere is like and what things they emphasize.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All the volunteering that I've been doing has made every day feel so fulfilling...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm really glad that I decided to try my hand at something new.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I really need to thank Mom again for giving me the push I needed.)
A few months earlier

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You got the highest scores out of all the second-years on those tests we took the other day, didn't you, Haruka?! You're so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The things I studied just happened to show up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you always make sure to review the things we cover in class and read ahead, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You even show us your notes from time to time! I can't tell you how much I respect you since I tend to space out after getting tired from practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. I didn't do very well on math this time around because of that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two have been working very hard in preparation for your next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have! And we need to keep practicing if we really want to move the hearts of the people who come and watch us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. Would you like it if I helped you with the parts you struggled with on those tests...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I was actually just thinking about looking over what came up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, thanks...! Then, it'll be a study session with just the three of us! That means we gotta go buy a bunch of snacks♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's fine, but our main goal going to be study.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Okay, this should be enough information for me to smoothly explain the key points behind each type of test question.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The amazing ones are Tenma and her band.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Because they're always doing what they can to give their audience the best shows possible...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (While I...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Haruka? Do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... Yeah, I can talk.
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Guess what...? There's an article in the evening paper about your favorite person. Remember her? She made you smile and laugh so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I didn't just smile and laugh...
She became my hero and gave me a dream.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can't face her anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: You can choose whether or not to read this article, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Maybe just a quick skim...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“Although she's retired from being an idol and stepped away from the spotlight, she continues to spread hope to others...”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“Now, following her retirement, she's become a radio personality for a station in another part of the country. However, her activities are not confined to a cramped studio.”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“Between retirement homes, kindergartens, hot springs and such, she uses her past experience as a star to stand on stages all over her region...”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“And so, she continues to spread hope and inspire courage in others with her dazzling smile and beautiful voice.”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
She hasn't changed at all...
Just look at the way she's smiling while being surrounded by these children.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Her smile really is rosy...
It has this way of filling your heart with joyous light...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even now, she's spreading hope to lots of people.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She really is an amazing person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wish...I could've been like her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: If you feel that way... Why don't you give it another try?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Reading this article, I realized that there are many ways to make people smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Which means... You may yet find the path that's just right for you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I never thought about spreading hope to others without being an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What if I rob someone of their hope again...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to put you on the spot like that. You don't have to answer right away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Regardless of what you choose to do, you'll have my support. Please take your time and prioritize your own feelings.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I don't know if there's anything I can do for other people anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But if there's even the slightest possibility...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (After that, I began volunteering a lot for these events...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I still don't think I'll ever be like her.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even still, getting to help others even just a little bit makes me feel happy and fulfilled.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So, for now... I'll just focus on what I can do for the people around me.)
A few days later
Nursing Home

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for having me today.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady A
rows.Line: It's so nice to have adorable students such as yourselves come and visit. Lately, I've had no one to talk to, so I've been very bored.

rows.Speaker: Student Volunteer
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, we can spend lots of time chatting today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We also have a quiz tournament planned for later, so we hope you enjoy that as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I recall, we're supposed to go around and speak with everyone until it's recreation time.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I think I can leave these two to talk, so I'll try someone else.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
Come to think of it, that lady in the wheelchair's been sitting alone by the window for a while now. I hope she's feeling okay...)

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Nobuko likes to stare at the sky like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, is there a reason why?

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Until not too long ago, she used to be very talkative... She loved to exercise and take walks around the facility. But she fell ill and lost the use of her legs.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Her legs...

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line:
She's been feeling very blue ever since.
Keeping active seemed to be her reason for living.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Her reason for living...)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, Nobuko.
Would you mind if we chatted for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The sky's beautiful today, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: It is...

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: But it's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: It's so nice outside, but I can't go out and take a walk...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we go outside together?

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is there anywhere you'd like to go? I'll happily go with you.

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: Oh, in that case...

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: Would you mind pushing my wheelchair?
A few weeks later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello, Nobuko.

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line:
Oh, you're back again.
I've been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: I've been wanting to go somewhere with you again.

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: Ever since I was little, I've always loved to travel.

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: Climbing bluffs to get so close to the sky I could touch the stars, adventuring through caves to find beautiful flower fields on the other side...

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: These legs took me to discover so many new places. And I had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: Which is why... I was totally crushed when I found out that I couldn't walk anymore. The future seemed dark and empty.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nobuko...

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: But I feel like I've been making more discoveries during our walks compared to when I was going out and about on my own.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: Because of you, I feel a little more optimistic about life.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Because of me...?)

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line:
Thank you, Haruka.
For giving me hope.

rows.Speaker: Nobuko
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we met.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm also glad that we met...
